Veterinary Clinic Het Hart van Zuid
Received fantastic help! A bit nerve-wracking at first, but then skipping through the waiting room. My dog ​​Louis and I are super happy!

Took my dog to this vet clinic today and the service was flawless from start to finish. Everyone was super attentive, from reception to the vet herself, both to us and especially to our dog. You can tell they genuinely care about animals, it's not just routine. Left really happy to have found this place, highly recommend.
Professional, skilled care. Very helpful and good communication.
